description:
In this iconic episode of Rod Serling’s classic anthology series, wealthy and dying Jason Foster (Robert Keith) hosts his greedy family for a mandatory Mardi Gras party. As a condition of their inheritance, he forces his daughter, son-in-law, and grandchildren to wear hideous, distorted masks. After delivering a final chilling speech from his chair, Jason passes away leaving his family to face the ultimate shocking reveal as they remove their masks. Season 5 Episode 25: The Masks.
